name: Alandalus Property Company
summary: Alandalus Property Company, a real estate company, engages in investment, development, and operation of commercial real estate properties in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company constructs, owns, and manages commercial and residential complexes and centers. It also involved in the general contracting services for residential and commercial buildings, educational, recreational, and healthcare buildings, as well as roads, dams, water and sewage projects, and electrical and mechanical works. In addition, the company provides maintenance and operation of real estate properties, buildings, and commercial facilities.
